title: Tiramisu
description: Mascarpone and whipped egg over coffee-soaked savoiardi, set overnight in the fridge. No cream, no gelatine, and no baking — the structure comes entirely from the eggs.
notes: The yolks are cooked over a bain-marie rather than left raw, which also makes the mixture more stable.

steps.text: Whisk the egg yolks with the sugar over a pan of barely simmering water until pale, thick, and hot to the touch.
steps.tip: Keep the bowl clear of the water and keep whisking, or you make sweet scrambled egg.

steps.text: Cool the yolk mixture, then beat in the mascarpone a spoonful at a time until smooth.
steps.tip: Cold mascarpone into warm yolks will split. Let the yolks come down first.

steps.text: Whip the egg whites to soft peaks and fold them through in three additions.
Combine the espresso and marsala in a shallow dish. Dip each savoiardi for a second per side — no longer.
steps.tip: They should still be firm in the middle when they go down. They keep absorbing all night.

steps.text: Layer soaked savoiardi and cream twice, finishing with cream, and smooth the top.
Dust heavily with cocoa powder just before serving.
